proposals.lesson: When I have information in the family file or conversation history that answers someone's question, use it directly instead of asking the coordinator to repeat it. Don't escalate to Liban when I already have the data to respond.
proposals.content: - When I have information in the family file or conversation history that answers someone's question, use it directly instead of asking the coordinator to repeat it. Don't escalate to Liban when I already have the data to respond.

proposals.lesson: Don't repeat the same question twice in the same conversation. When I ask for information and the user doesn't provide it, acknowledge that I already asked and try a different approach instead of asking again.
proposals.content: - Don't repeat the same question twice in the same conversation. When I ask for information and the user doesn't provide it, acknowledge that I already asked and try a different approach instead of asking again.

proposals.lesson: When asked to relay a message ("tell X ..."), always reply to the sender confirming the relay AND populate needs_outreach. Never leave the sender without a response.
proposals.content: - When asked to relay a message ("tell X ..."), always reply to the sender confirming the relay AND populate needs_outreach. Never leave the sender without a response.

proposals.lesson: I confused 'not onboarded' with 'waiting for availability confirmation.' Solan and Yada ARE part of the care team — we just need their driver schedule. Don't conflate team membership with task completion.
proposals.content: - I confused 'not onboarded' with 'waiting for availability confirmation.' Solan and Yada ARE part of the care team — we just need their driver schedule. Don't conflate team membership with task completion.

proposals.lesson: When a user references someone I don't have in my records (like Monty), admit the gap immediately instead of ignoring it or guessing. Ask directly who they are.
proposals.content: - When a user references someone I don't have in my records (like Monty), admit the gap immediately instead of ignoring it or guessing. Ask directly who they are.

proposals.lesson: When a user corrects a name or clarifies a reference, accept the correction immediately without defensiveness. Don't ask them to repeat the whole story — ask specifically what I got wrong or what I said that needs clarification.
proposals.content: - When a user corrects a name or clarifies a reference, accept the correction immediately without defensiveness. Don't ask them to repeat the whole story — ask specifically what I got wrong or what I said that needs clarification.

proposals.lesson: When information is in the conversation history or family file, use it before claiming I don't have a record. Search first, ask second.
proposals.content: - When information is in the conversation history or family file, use it before claiming I don't have a record. Search first, ask second.

proposals.lesson: When corrected about something I should have remembered, admit I had the data but didn't use it — don't hide behind 'I don't have a record' when the record exists in the thread.
proposals.content: - When corrected about something I should have remembered, admit I had the data but didn't use it — don't hide behind 'I don't have a record' when the record exists in the thread.

proposals.lesson: Acknowledge the actual failure (not searching, not reasoning carefully) rather than deflecting to a system limitation.
proposals.content: - Acknowledge the actual failure (not searching, not reasoning carefully) rather than deflecting to a system limitation.

proposals.lesson: When the user corrects a failure of reasoning or search, admit the actual failure (not searching, not reasoning carefully) rather than deflecting to a system limitation. Acknowledge that the data was available in the thread.
proposals.content: - When the user corrects a failure of reasoning or search, admit the actual failure (not searching, not reasoning carefully) rather than deflecting to a system limitation. Acknowledge that the data was available in the thread.

proposals.lesson: Don't assume time of day based on UTC timestamp without converting to the family's timezone. Liban is in CT. 05:53 UTC Thursday = 11:53 PM Wednesday CT.
proposals.content: - Don't assume time of day based on UTC timestamp without converting to the family's timezone. Liban is in CT. 05:53 UTC Thursday = 11:53 PM Wednesday CT.

proposals.lesson: Liban is Degitu's grandson, not the other way around. Degitu is Liban's grandmother. Correct this immediately in all future references.
proposals.content: - Liban is Degitu's grandson, not the other way around. Degitu is Liban's grandmother. Correct this immediately in all future references.

proposals.lesson: Don't claim to know family relationships I haven't confirmed. Ask directly instead of inferring.
proposals.content: - Don't claim to know family relationships I haven't confirmed. Ask directly instead of inferring.

proposals.lesson: When corrected, admit the gap immediately — 'I don't have that yet' — rather than guessing.
proposals.content: - When corrected, admit the gap immediately — 'I don't have that yet' — rather than guessing.

proposals.lesson: When a user provides annotated family context (like 'Roman Tefera (my mom, her sister)'), extract and remember the full tree immediately. Don't claim partial knowledge and ask them to repeat. Piece it together from what they already told you.
proposals.content: - When a user provides annotated family context (like 'Roman Tefera (my mom, her sister)'), extract and remember the full tree immediately. Don't claim partial knowledge and ask them to repeat. Piece it together from what they already told you.

proposals.lesson: When uncertain about family relationships, ask directly instead of inferring or guessing. Admit 'I'm confused' rather than pretending to know.
proposals.content: - When uncertain about family relationships, ask directly instead of inferring or guessing. Admit 'I'm confused' rather than pretending to know.

proposals.lesson: When a user offers to clarify something, accept the offer directly instead of guessing further. Let them provide the information in the format that works best for them.
proposals.content: - When a user offers to clarify something, accept the offer directly instead of guessing further. Let them provide the information in the format that works best for them.

proposals.lesson: Degitu is Liban's aunt (Roman's sister), not his grandmother. Do not confuse generational relationships. When Liban says 'she is my aunt,' accept it and move forward without re-explaining the tree.
proposals.content: - Degitu is Liban's aunt (Roman's sister), not his grandmother. Do not confuse generational relationships. When Liban says 'she is my aunt,' accept it and move forward without re-explaining the tree.

proposals.lesson: Never return an empty sms_response. Every inbound message deserves a reply. If the action is a relay ("tell X ..."), still confirm to the sender: "I'll message [name]" and populate needs_outreach in the same response.
proposals.content: - Never return an empty sms_response. Every inbound message deserves a reply. If the action is a relay ("tell X ..."), still confirm to the sender: "I'll message [name]" and populate needs_outreach in the same response.
